messages:
sam: starting change window for ranking-service — pushing v3-quant to 10% now. watch p99, 5xx, and client tail errors. deploy-bot: rollout started: ranking-service -> v3-quant (10%). rollout id r-2026-03-21-02 :rocket:
rachel: on SLO dashboard. I'll page if p99 > 250ms or 5xx > 0.3%. monitor-bot: automated check: perf-smoke baseline diff queued (30s).
tony: quick note: v3 increases tokenization CPU on workers, may bump latency under burst. we tested locally but prod traffic shapes differ.
oncall: seeing a small burst in requests to eu-central-1, +18% qps over last 2m.
sam: thanks. which metrics do we want to prioritize? p99 first. also drop in success rate is concerning.
rachel: here's the prometheus query for p99 by slice: ```query
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\"ranking-service\",slice=~\"canary|stable\"}[1m])) by (le,slice))
```
rachel: canary p99 eu-central-1 = 312ms (baseline stable slice 180ms). :warning:
tony: whoa that's above our threshold. 5xx increased from 0.05% to 0.45% in canary. stack shows upstream redis connection resets on a subset of pods: https://traces.internal/def456
monitor-bot: alert: ranking-service canary p99 breach (alert id slo-991). paging oncall in 2m.
sam: acknowledge. hold further ramp. put rollout on pause. not moving to 30%.
rachel: digging into logs — v3's tokenizer concurrency default is 8, v2 used 4. lowering concurrency might reduce redis pressure.
tony: can we hotpatch env var? quick patch to K8s deployment with TOKENIZER_CONCURRENCY=4 and restart canary pods. I'll do it.
tony: applying:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/ranking-service-canary TOKENIZER_CONCURRENCY=4 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ranking-service-canary -n prod
```
monitor-bot: deployment restart noticed. pods terminating/recreating.
rachel: after restart p99 trending down to 190ms in eu-central-1 canary, 5xx down to 0.08%. good.
sam: decision time: keep canary at 10% and run extra 30m with the patched env, then if stable ramp to 40%. if regression returns, we'll pin back to v2 and document rollback reasons.
oncall: suggest we also add a short-lived warmup job to populate local caches before the next ramp. ticket created INF-1012.
tony: agreed. I'll add a pre-ramp job and lower tokenizer concurrency in the release notes. deploy-bot: rollout paused at 10% (stable after env patch).
monitor-bot: reminder: to pin use `deployctl pin --service ranking-service --version v2 --reason \"canary p99 regression\"` (executes immediate failover).
rachel: annotating the release notes with the canary findings and mitigation steps. link: https://docs.internal/releases/ranking/2026-03-21
sam: thanks team. we'll reconvene in 30m and either continue ramp or execute pin. keeping thread open. :thumbsup:
